reason: Fixations cluster tightly in a small code-region–like area (x≈280–400, y≈430–480) with many short regressions and re-readings of nearly the same lines, indicating intensive local reasoning rather than global scanning. There is no systematic horizontal line-by-line reading (READ) or broad vertical navigation (SEARCH/BROWSE), nor wide, screen-spanning shifts (PLAY/WATCH). The focused, back-and-forth scrutiny over a constrained area aligns best with interpreting a code snippet’s behavior (INTERPRET).
